project.title: aquascape-expansion-v11-mopani_wood-views-r2
project.description: Twenty-asset scenery expansion using independently generated full-resolution cameras. Reuse accepted four existing assets. Code automation reduces repeated Codex work in 3D construction, not artwork detail.
project.art_direction: Match the supplied approved aquarium pixel illustration finish: fine deliberate crisp pixel clusters, broad coherent painted color masses, natural material planes, subtle detailed highlights and restrained color. No smooth CGI, no photo noise, no uniform speckling. Isolated on pure white, no floor, water, cast shadow or scenery. No labels, panels, collage, text or extra views. One complete object fills most of this image with clean margins. Keep source resolution: this is one full-resolution artwork, not a multi-view sheet.
project.gameplay_loop: Inspect twenty scenery assets in a native Godot catalogue, including ten animated plant species.
project.session_goal: Distinct source-matched generated props and plant anatomy with explicit species and independent views.

assets.name: mopani_wood_right
assets.description:
Render the EXACT SAME object from the supplied front artwork: . A dense gnarled low mopani driftwood, contrasting honey tan smooth worn face and very dark brown underside, compact twisting solid trunk with short stout root feet.
Match the supplied approved aquarium pixel illustration finish: fine deliberate crisp pixel clusters, broad coherent painted color masses, natural material planes, subtle detailed highlights and restrained color. No smooth CGI, no photo noise, no uniform speckling. Isolated on pure white, no floor, water, cast shadow or scenery. No labels, panels, collage, text or extra views. Camera exactly at the RIGHT END looking along -X. Orthographic perpendicular END ELEVATION. X length disappears into the screen; horizontal image dimension is Z depth and vertical is Y height. Long front limbs become foreshortened cross-sections. Do not repeat the long front facade. No camera tilt.
Keep the same physical branches, holes, roof, openings and broken edges. Infer hidden surfaces consistently. One complete object with clean margins; no labels, diagrams or extra views.
